title: Jennifer Davies joins AXIS as Active Underwriter for Lloyd’s Syndicate 1686
summary: Jennifer Davies Joins AXIS as Active Underwriter for Lloyds Syndicate 1686 PEMBROKE, Bermuda, July 30, 2026 AXIS Capital Holdings Limited (AXIS Capital or AXIS or the Company) (NYSE: AXS), today announced the appointment of Jennifer Davies as Active Underwriter for AXIS Syndicate 1686. Ms. Davies will be responsible for overseeing all underwriting and related business activities of Syndicate 1686, succeeding Toby Read. She will report to Mr. Read who retains his role as Chief Underwriting Officer for AXIS Managing Agency and continues as a member of the AXIS Global Markets leadership team.
